notes: Added a maps_link column to GPS_Log (a plain https://www.google.com/maps?q=lat,lon URL -- Google Sheets auto-links plain http(s):// text the same way Apps Script's sheet.appendRow() writes it, no =HYPERLINK() formula needed). Also fixed the real reason GPS_Log stayed empty while Power_Log kept getting rows from the same 'log'/'log_now' command: sheets_log.py's log_gps() existed but NOTHING ever called it -- neither ble_service.py's BLE 'log' command nor field_console.py's web '/log' page ever attempted a GPS fix. Added SheetsLogger.log_gps_now(), which reuses the already-open cellular modem's UART (no second UART on the same pins) to get one GPS fix attempt (20s timeout -- a quick best-effort, not a guarantee, especially without a dedicated GPS antenna) and logs it to GPS_Log with status='fix' or 'no_fix'. Wired into both the BLE 'log' command and the web console's Log Now page, with power and GPS outcomes tracked and reported independently so a GPS no-fix doesn't hide a successful power log or vice versa. sheets_bootstrap.py's GPS_Log header list now includes maps_link -- re-run it (or manually add the column) so existing sheets get the new header.
